title: Ansel and the Bell
author: Petra Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Brightwater, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
